_comment: The book's identity on Amazon, in one place. The ASIN is currently hard-coded into fourteen files, so republishing the combined edition would otherwise mean fourteen hand-edits and one silent miss pointing readers at a delisted book. tools/check-book.mjs proves every link agrees with this file; tools/set-asin.mjs rewrites them all when the ASIN changes.
title: Cleared For Takeoff: The Complete Edition

retired_asins.B0GS21NW58: Cleared For Take-Off (taken down by Naomi, 27 Sep 2026)
retired_asins.B0GWXL6SLD: How to Win Every Argument By Outlasting Your Opponent's Memory (taken down by Naomi, 27 Sep 2026)

_status_note: While status is coming-soon there must be NO amazon.com.au/dp/ link on the site, and tools/check-book.mjs fails if one appears. Pages say 'coming soon' and link to /book/. When the Complete Edition has an ASIN: run `node tools/set-asin.mjs <NEW_ASIN>` (sets status live), then add the buy links back by hand to /book/ (hero and #buy), and optionally the footer notes on the homepage and the ten audience pages. check-book then requires at least one link and that every link matches.
